cases.case_label: SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP): RAN translation of (AGAGGG)n repeat in vitro
cases.mechanism_detail: Reporter constructs carrying the XDP SVA (AGAGGG)n repeat undergo repeat-associated non-AUG translation in HEK293 cells, producing poly-(Glu-Gly) and poly-(Arg-Glu) dipeptide repeat proteins that form nuclear inclusions; in vitro proof of principle only, no patient tissue.
cases.quote: XDP RAN translation initiates within the (AGAGGGn sequence and poly-(Glu-Gly) DPRs formed nuclear inclusions in transfected cells.
